products.name: DJI Air 3 Fly More Combo With DJI RC 2 Remote Controller
products.description:
DJI Air 3 Fly More Combo With DJI RC 2 Remote Controller

The DJI Air 3 Drone Combo With DJI RC-N2 Remote Controller is a strong and flexible drone that provides breathtaking and smooth aerial photography. The drone has two cameras, one wide-angle and one medium-telephoto, both with 1/1.3-inch CMOS sensors and 48 megapixels. The drone can record 4K movies at 60 frames per second with HDR or 4K films at 100 frames per second for slow motion effects. The drone also supports D-Log M and HLG color profiles, which provide post-processing versatility and creativity. The drone weighs 720 grams and has a maximum flying duration of 46 minutes. The drone also includes omnidirectional obstacle detection, which allows it to identify and avoid obstacles in all directions. The drone comes with the DJI RC-N2 Remote Controller, which includes a DJI O4 transmission technology that can send a 1080p/60fps video feed up to 20km away. The remote controller also has a maximum takeoff height of 6km, allowing you to explore higher and further. The DJI Air 3 Fly More Combo With DJI RC 2 Remote Controller is an excellent alternative for consumers looking for a high-performance and dependable drone for photography and filming.

Aircraft Performance and Capabilities

The DJI Air 3 Drone has a sleek and compact design with folding arms and propellers for simple transport and storage. It weighs only 720 g, but because of its large battery, it can fly for up to 46 minutes on a single charge. It can also attain a high speed of 21 meters per second (19 meters per second in EU countries) and a maximum altitude of 6000 meters, providing you with lots of range and versatility. The drone features an omnidirectional binocular vision system with an infrared sensor at the bottom that can detect and avoid objects in all directions. It also has a worldwide navigation satellite system (GPS + Galileo + BeiDou) for precise location and hovering. The drone features 8 GB of onboard storage and accepts microSD cards up to 512 GB for additional storage.

Camera Features and Specifications

The DJI Air 3 Drone has a dual-camera system with a wide-angle and a medium-tele camera, both having 1/1.3-inch CMOS sensors and 48 MP effective pixels. The camera has an 82° field of view, a format equivalent of 24 mm, an aperture of f/1.7, and a focus range of 1 m. The 35° FOV camera has a format equivalent to 70 mm, an aperture of f/2.8, and a focus range of 3 m. The dual-camera system lets you take images and films from various viewpoints and zoom settings. With the remote controller or the app, you can effortlessly switch between the two cameras. You may also utilize digital zoom to come closer to your topic without sacrificing quality. The wide-angle camera has a zoom range of 1-3x, while the medium-tele camera has a zoom range of 3–9x. The DJI Air 3 can record movies in H.264/H.265 codecs at resolutions up to 4K at 100 frames per second (only H.265). Depending on your preferences and editing needs, you may also select alternative color modes and sampling techniques, such as Normal, HLG, or D-Log M. Vertical shooting options for social media sites are also supported by the drone. The DJI Air 3 can shoot JPEG/DNG (RAW) photographs with resolutions up to 80646048 pixels. You may also select between other still photography modes, such as Single Shot, Burst Shooting, Automatic Exposure Bracketing (AEB), and Timed Shot. The drone also has simulated long exposure modes that may be used to capture light trails or water flows.

Gimbal Stabilization and Control

A 3-axis mechanical gimbal stabilizes the camera and delivers flawless footage on the DJI Air 3 Drone . The mechanical range of the gimbal is -135° to 70° (tilt), -50° to 50° (roll), and -27° to 27° (pan), while the controlled range is -90° to 60° (tilt) and -5° to 5° (pan). The gimbal has a maximum control speed of 100 degrees per second (tilt) and an angular vibration range of 0.0037 degrees.

Video Transmission

The DJI Air 3 Drone has the O4 video transmission system, which sends high-quality live view photos from the drone to your mobile device or remote controller. The video transmission system uses three frequency bands: 2.4 GHz, 5.1 GHz, and 5.8 GHz, and it can transition between them automatically to minimize interference. The video transmission system may give live view quality up to 1080p at 60 frames per second, with a maximum download speed of 10 MB/s (when using the DJI RC-N2 Remote Controller or the DJI RC 2) or Wi-Fi at 5:30 MB/s (when using compatible mobile devices). In addition, the video transmission system may achieve a low latency of around 120 ms (depending on the real environment and mobile device). The video transmission system may enable a maximum transmission distance of up to 20 km (FCC), depending on the real environment and interference level. To deliver a solid and dependable signal, the video transmission system employs six antennas in a 2T4R configuration.

DJI RC 2 Remote Controller

The DJI RC 2 Remote Controller is a remote controller that allows you to control your DJI drone in a simple and straightforward manner. The remote controller has a 5.5-inch 1080p FHD screen that displays the drone's video feed clearly and brightly. The screen offers a brightness of 700 nits, making it easy to view even in direct sunlight. The remote controller now includes DJI O4 video transmission, which provides better anti-interference capabilities and crystal-clear, low-latency video transmission over a maximum range of 20 kilometers. A 2T4R antenna on the remote controller ensures stable and consistent communication. The remote controller's battery life is impressive, lasting up to 3 hours of continuous operation. The remote control also offers live streaming.

products.name: DJI Air 3S Fly More Combo With DJI RC 2 Remote Controller
products.description:
DJI Air 3S Fly More Combo With DJI RC 2 Remote Controller

The DJI Air 3S Fly More Combo with DJI RC 2 Remote Controller comes with a dual-camera system that includes a 1-inch CMOS wide-angle camera with 50MP effective pixels and a 1/1.3-inch CMOS medium tele camera with 48MP effective pixels, capturing stunning 4K/60fps HDR video with 14 stops of dynamic range. Its omnidirectional obstacle sensing ensures safe and precise navigation in a variety of environments. The DJI Air 3S has a remarkable 45-minute flight time and a video transmission range of 20 kilometers, providing extended operational capabilities. The wide-angle camera has a 24mm format equivalent and an f/1.8 aperture, whereas the medium-tele camera has a 70mm format equivalent and an f/2.8 aperture, allowing for a variety of shooting angles. The DJI Air 3S Fly More Combo with DJI RC 2 Controller has ISO ranges optimized for a variety of shooting modes, including slow motion, HDR, and D-Log M, as well as adjustable shutter speeds for long exposures. Capture high-resolution stills in JPEG and DNG (RAW) formats, with maximum image sizes of 8192×6144 for the wide-angle camera and 8064×6048 for the medium-tele camera.

1" CMOS Primary Camera

The DJI Air 3S Fly More Combo's primary camera features a 1-inch CMOS sensor that supports 4K/60fps HDR and 4K/120fps video recording, as well as 10-bit D-Log M color mode. This large sensor, combined with advanced image-processing technology and intelligent algorithms, captures even the smallest details in low-light conditions like sunsets and nightscapes, resulting in shots that are simply breathtaking. The DJI Air 3S Fly More Combo Drone has a 1-inch-CMOS primary camera and a 70mm medium tele camera, both of which have up to 14 stops of dynamic range and can capture landscapes, portraits, and other images in stunning detail.

Dual-Camera 4K/60fps HDR Video

The DJI Air 3S Fly More Combo has a dual-camera system consisting of a 1-inch CMOS primary camera and a 1/1.3-inch CMOS medium telecamera. The primary camera has a larger CMOS sensor and a 24mm lens, making it ideal for photographing large landscapes with high clarity and a wide field of view. The 70mm medium tele camera excels at portrait and vehicle photography, with compressed depth of field that highlights any subject in a bolder, more cinematic way.

Medium Tele Camera

The medium tele camera, with a 48MP 1/1.3-inch CMOS sensor, has the same video specifications and color modes as the primary camera. Its 70mm lens provides 3x optical zoom, allowing you to take unique shots from a distance while highlighting your subject. You can also take detailed and expressive close-up portraits by orbiting around a subject and recording a 4K video with the DJI Air 3S Fly More Combo.

Nightscape Omnidirectional Obstacle Sensing

The Advanced Pilot Assistance Systems (APAS) are compatible with the DJI Air 3S Fly More Combo. A downward infrared time-of-flight (ToF) sensor and six vision sensors (two at the front, rear, and bottom) are also included in the Air 3S, the first DJI drone with forward-facing LiDAR, to enable omnidirectional obstacle sensing in nighttime. This function ensures strong safety for nighttime photography by allowing the drone to recognize and avoid obstacles, like buildings, automatically during its flight and return routes.

Next-Gen Smart RTH With Enhanced Precision

With the help of technologies for map creation and real-time vision positioning, the DJI Air 3S Fly More Combo can remember flight routes in well-lit environments. This guarantees a safe return even when taking off from places like balconies that don't have satellite signals. The DJI Air 3S's forward-facing LiDAR ensures safer nighttime returns by detecting obstacles like tall buildings and navigating upward around them, even in low light.

DJI Goggles 3

All you need to do to pilot the Avata 2 drone and experience an engrossing and visually stimulating flight through the skies is to tilt your head or wrist. With its new Real View PiP technology and DJI O4 low-latency video transmission, the Goggles 3 provides dependable safety and stability for your flights.

DJI RC Motion 3

With just the touch of a button, the DJI RC Motion 3 offers thrilling, dynamic flight maneuvers while keeping operating straightforward and user-friendly. 1/1.3-inch CMOS Sensor

The DJI Avata 2 drone features an advanced 1/1.3-inch CMOS sensor that increases the filmed dynamic range and handles low-light conditions more effectively, resulting in amazing footage on every flight. Realize your full aerial potential. The amazing sensation of fast-moving objects is captured by the Avata 2's 4K/60fps HDR.

Tight Shots in Super-Wide 4K

With the DJI Avata 2 drone's 155° field of view and its ability to move quickly toward and away from targets, you can create amazing images. Experienced drone operators can effortlessly execute aerobatic maneuvers and snap swift, dramatic, low-altitude images beyond the reach of other drones.

155° Ultra-Wide-Angle FOV

Further simplify color grading while capturing excellent richness in highlights and shadows and improving post-production opportunities for content.

Advanced Positioning With New Sensors

O4 Video Transmission

The DJI Avata 2 Fly Smart Combo Drone is a compact drone designed for immersive aerial experiences. It weighs approximately 377 g and features a diagonal size of 185×212×64 mm. The drone supports a maximum flight time of 23 minutes and can reach speeds up to 27 m/s in manual mode. Equipped with a 1/1.3-inch CMOS super-wide-angle camera, it delivers 12 MP stills and 4K video at multiple frame rates. The DJI Avata 2 Fly Smart Combo integrates GPS, Galileo, and BeiDou positioning systems, ensuring accurate hovering and stable navigation. Its operating temperature range spans -10° to 40° C, making it suitable for diverse environments.

Immersive Flight Experience

The DJI Avata 2 Fly Smart Combo offers an unmatched immersive flight experience with advanced goggles and intuitive controls. Pilots enjoy real-time 1080p live view at up to 100 fps, enhancing situational awareness. The drone’s binocular fisheye visual positioning system ensures precise stability during low-altitude flights. With a maximum service ceiling of 5000 m, the DJI Avata 2 Fly Smart Combo adapts to challenging terrains. Its turtle mode allows recovery after minor crashes, adding resilience to every flight.

Intuitive Motion Control

The DJI Avata 2 Fly Smart Combo introduces intuitive motion control for effortless piloting. The remote controller operates within 2.400-2.4835 GHz frequency, offering up to 10 hours of use. The drone responds smoothly to hand movements, enabling natural navigation. Its single-axis mechanical gimbal ensures tilt stabilization, maintaining cinematic footage even during dynamic maneuvers. The DJI Avata 2 Fly Smart Combo supports RockSteady 3.0+ and HorizonSteady, reducing vibration and delivering fluid video output.

Easy ACRO Performance

The DJI Avata 2 Fly Smart Combo simplifies ACRO maneuvers for beginners and professionals. With ascent speeds up to 9 m/s in sport mode, it delivers agile performance. The drone’s maximum angular vibration range of ±0.01° ensures precision during flips and rolls. Its controllable tilt range from -80° to +65° provides creative flexibility. The DJI Avata 2 Fly Smart Combo empowers pilots to explore advanced aerial tricks without compromising stability or safety.

Super-Wide 4K Content

The DJI Avata 2 Fly Smart Combo captures tight shots in super-wide 4K resolution. Its 155° field of view lens and f/2.8 aperture deliver sharp visuals in diverse lighting. Video formats include MP4 with H.264 or H.265 encoding, supporting bitrates up to 130 Mbps. The drone records at multiple resolutions, including 4K/60fps and 1080p/120fps. The DJI Avata 2 Fly Smart Combo ensures hassle-free POV content creation, making every flight a cinematic experience.

products.name: DJI Avata Fly Smart Drone Combo with FPV Goggles V2
products.description:
DJI Avata Fly Smart Combo with FPV Goggles V2

The DJI Avata Fly Smart Drone Combo allows you to capture stable, ultra-wide 4K stabilized footage indoors or outdoors, in and around obstacles. The Avata has a "cinewhoop" design and a palm-sized form factor, with all four propellers covered by connected guards. This enables close-up filming indoors, near people, and via small apertures without endangering people or property. If the Avata does come into touch, it may just bounce off and continue flying. With the Fly Smart Combo, piloting the DJI Avata is an immersive and intuitive experience with the included FPV Goggles V2 and Motion Controller. The FPV Goggles V2 are equipped with two built-in 2" screens, each sporting a resolution of 1440 x 810 for an 810p live feed from Avata's point of view. The Motion Controller delivers a unique and natural method of flying, where instead of a typical gamepad-style remote, you squeeze a trigger to fly forward and swivel your wrist to turn corners.

Wide-Angle Stabilized Video

The DJI Avata Fly Smart Drone Combo has a 48MP 1/1.7" CMOS sensor that supports up to 4K video at 100 fps. The footage is stabilized in two ways: RockSteady 2.0 EIS and HorizonSteady EIS. RockSteady EIS works to reduce camera shake, while HorizonSteady locks the Avata's footage to a level horizon.

DJI FPV Goggles V2

The Avata's ultra-wide 155° FOV offers first-person piloting with the DJI FPV Goggles V2 a thrilling experience. The goggles get a constant transmission from the DJI O3+ system through dual-band Wi-Fi 5 (802.11ac) and may run for up to 110 minutes per charge. The live video you see is meant to be vivid and seamless owing to twin built-in 2" displays, each having a resolution of 1440 x 810 and a fast 144 Hz refresh rate.

O3+ Transmission

Using 2T2R omnidirectional antennas, the Avata can provide video with a 30 ms latency and a data transmission rate of 50 Mb/s to the FPV Goggles V2. When storing movies, the film is compressed with H.265 to reduce storage space, and it may be transferred from up to 6.2 miles away.

Obstacle Sensing & Turtle Mode

During the flight, a downward binocular vision sensor and a ToF depth sensor collaborate to identify obstructions on the ground. This enables pilots to safely fly low-altitude and interior missions. The propeller guards typically allow the Avata to endure a bump and keep flying, but what if the Avata hits hard enough to plummet and rest on its back like a turtle? Simply engage Turtle Mode with a few clicks to have the Avata flip itself right side up and resume flight.

Drone Safety

If you suspect an approaching collision, you can immediately use the emergency brake button to bring the Avata to a complete stop and hover in place. RTH (Return to Home) is another safety function that automatically returns the drone to its starting position if the battery runs out or the communication to the remote is lost.

Virtual Flight App

This app, which is designed for Windows, iOS 12.0+, and Android 9.0+, allows beginners and expert pilots to practice flying inside and outdoors, sharpening their abilities from a choice of preconfigured simulated settings. The DJI Avata Fly Smart Drone Combo with FPV Goggles V2 has No Warranty.

products.name: DJI Inspire 3 Drone
products.description:
DJI Inspire 3 Drone

The DJI Inspire 3 is an all-in-one 8K camera drone allows experienced filmmakers to maximize the possibilities of any image and master the unseen. Waypoint Pro, which was created specifically for aerial cinematography, allows for flight-route and shoot preparation with a variety of customizable parameters. An novel automated shooting experience may be readily achieved with the new Repeatable Routes and 3D Dolly modes. Furthermore, RTK centimeter-level location ensures more precise flight planning and execution. Use Waypoint Pro to handle even the most difficult sequences, whether you're shooting alone or with a professional crew. The X9-8K Air is an 8K full-frame, 3-axis gimbal camera that was made specifically for the Inspire 3. With double the DFOV of the Inspire 2, it complements a newly added 1/1.8" FPV camera. Thanks to a programmable obstacle avoidance system, integrated centimeter-level RTK precision, and tracking solutions that enable precise and repeatable shots, they work together to assist shoot professional video and complex shots.

Innovative Design

The Inspire 3 Drone is a professional camera drone that features a sleek, modern design that completely considers aerodynamics to minimize air resistance. The vertical ascend/descend speed has increased from 6 m/s and 4 m/s to 8 m/s, while the maximum dive speed has increased from 9 m/s of Inspire 2 to 10 m/s. Strong maneuverability allows for up to 28 minutes of extended flight time and responsive, precise handling. For a sleek, contemporary industrial style, the FPV camera, visual sensors, location antennas, and storage card slot all have designs that are smoothly blended into the airframe. With a completely redesigned design that accommodates 360° Pan and Tilt Boost frameworks, the DJI Inspire 3 Drone carries on the tradition of the Inspire series' iconic transformable configuration. Cinematographers can record visually spectacular and inventive pictures with the gimbal's assistance for obstruction-free 80° upward-angle shooting when the landing gear is lowered. Every aspect of Inspire 3, from the exterior to the interior, was well thought out and optimized.

High-Mobility Precision with RTK Positioning

High-precision RTK positioning technology is integrated into the DJI Inspire 3 Drone to reach centimeter-level accuracy. This technology is used in various fields, including architecture and surveying. Compared to traditional meter-level positioning afforded by Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS), RTK not only enhances flying stability but also flight-route planning accuracy. This results in a significant boost in creative productivity. The unique stacked ceramic architecture of the RTK antennas built into the aircraft allows for dual-frequency positioning down to the centimeter level and facilitates three GNSS types: GPS, BeiDou, and Galileo. By setting a D-RTK 2 Mobile Station or turning on an RTK network, users can achieve exceptionally accurate positioning without the need to attach any additional modules.

Built-In Stacked Ceramic Antenna

An integrated stacking ceramic antenna on the front and back of the Inspire 3 Drone has strong anti-magnetic interference capabilities to further enhance flying safety and accuracy. The aircraft will automatically fly on the same path while maintaining all pre-set parameters, including camera settings, gimbal angle, altitude, and speed, when it uses repeatable routes. Cinematographers can easily generate long-duration timelapses that show transitions like day to night or season to season by repeating the same flight mission or by flying at different times in the same location.

Nine Omnidirectional Sensing System

Nine sensors on the Inspire 3 allow for a powerful omnidirectional sensing system that can identify objects in all directions and offer complete flying protection. Every one of the four landing arms now has a fisheye camera, a first. With this design, obstacles from the airframe can be avoided when the landing gear is lifted, and when it is dropped, horizontal obstacle detection is possible. To help ensure increased flight safety and creative freedom, the DJI Inspire 3 Drone also has a new customisable function. Obstacle detection in the horizontal, upward, and downward directions can be turned on or off separately, and the obstacle alert range can be manually adjusted to accommodate various situations. Even with active avoidance disabled, users can still see the distance to obstacles in real time on the navigation display and hear an audible alarm when one approaches within a predetermined range without the aircraft making an automatic maneuver to avoid it. Professional aerial teams now have additional options to work with when trying to generate more intricate camera language.

FPV Camera with Ultra-Wide Night Vision

The new 1/1.8-inch sensor FPV camera on the DJI Inspire 3 Drone has 3μm pixel size, 161° ultra-wide DFOV, and 1080p/60fps live feed transmission capability. The DFOV is roughly double that of its predecessor. With its enhanced light-sensing ability, this FPV camera ensures higher levels of flight safety by enabling pilots to see their surroundings clearly and vividly, especially at night.

8K Full-Frame Imaging System

The X9-8K Air, DJI's lightest full-frame three-axis gimbal camera, was designed specifically for the Inspire 3 to elevate drone filmmaking. It has DJI's most recent image processing technology, CineCore 3.0, which can record internal video at up to 8K/25 frames per second for CinemaDNG and 8K/75 frames per second for Apple ProRes RAW, satisfying the demands of high-end TV and film productions. 8K refers to extremely high-definition aerial video with clarity that astounds viewers when viewed on bigger screens while maintaining a texture that is true to life and similar to what the human eye sees. The X9-8K Air's sensor is fully utilized in RAW, offering a ton of room for color grading and graphic effects. More creative editing choices are available when using the X9-8K Air in S&Q mode, which allows internal recording of up to full-frame 4K/120fps ProRes RAW footage without cropping.

DJI Cinema Color System (DCCS): Syncing Timecode for Multiple Cameras

The DJI Cinema Color System, which builds on DJI's advanced color science and technology, enables the X9-8K Air to maintain true colors that completely change the appearance of aerial filmmaking. This holds true for both urban and natural locations, and it also correctly depicts skin tones under various lighting scenarios. In order to meet the demands of post-editing workflows in the film industry, DCCS guarantees seamless color matching between X9-8K Air and ground-based cinema cameras like DJI Ronin 4D. This uniform color style is delivered from air to ground. Equipment on the ground and in the air can synchronize timecode through the aircraft's 3.5mm connector. When editing a large amount of material from several cameras, timecode sync greatly simplifies and expedites the process.

O3 Pro, Cinema-Grade Video Transmission

With DJI's cinema-grade video transmission system, O3 Pro, the DJI Inspire 3 Drone can transmit video up to 15 km in single control mode and 12 km in dual control mode. The FPV camera and gimbal camera feature ultra-low latency of 90ms and support 1080p/60fps live feeds. O3 Pro offers transmission distance, latency, and stability improvements that represent a generational jump beyond those of the Lightbridge video transmission system of Inspire 2. To satisfy the demands of UHD monitoring and livestreaming on set, 4K/30fps live feeds are now available with a maximum transmission distance of 5km for the first time.

Fastest 1TB Storage Included

With the accompanying USB-C to USB-C connector, you can read the film on a computer directly without a card reader. The DJI PROSSD 1TB has a maximum read speed of 900MBps. With its four 360-degree rotating wheels, two side grips, and an extensible handle, the newly designed trolley case makes transitioning and moving about a breeze. For further security, there are two numbered locks installed. One airplane, one X9-8K Air gimbal camera, two RC Plus remote controllers, four lenses, twelve batteries, two battery charging hubs, three propeller sets, and more may all be stored in the thoughtfully built trolley case. Fresh quick-release folding propellers don't need to be reinstalled before every flight, making them simple to store.

Built for All-Day Shooting: Dual-Battery System

The new TB51 dual-battery system that powers the DJI Inspire 3 Drone makes use of the most recent advancements in battery chemistry technology to maximize dependability and performance. Comparing TB51 to TB50, the former has a greater voltage and the latter is smaller, lighter, and more streamlined. They have a maximum flying length of 28 minutes and enable hot swapping, which makes easy continuous operation possible. They also include a new battery release. The battery will activate an auto-heating feature if its temperature drops below 10° C (50° F). This will ensure that the battery can continue to work properly during flight, even in environments with -20° C (-4° F) temperatures. The brand-new foldable battery charging hub finds the ideal ratio between storage capacity and charging effectiveness. It has room for eight batteries. It can charge two batteries to 90% capacity in 35 minutes or eight cells to 100% capacity in 160 minutes when using the Fast mode. You may also use the accompanying 65W USB-C connector to charge an RC Plus.

Matrice 300 RTK is one of the smart and stronger drone of DJI. Checkout the key focused features and details below.


Improved Transmission System

DJI Matrice 300 RTK has The all-new OcuSync Enterprise enables transmission up to 15 km away and supports triple-channel3 1080p video. Real-time auto-switching between 2.4 GHz and 5.8 GHz4 enables more reliable flight near high-interference environments, while AES-256 encryption offers secure data transmission.

Enhanced Flight Performance

The refined airframe and propulsion system design gives you a more efficient and stable flight, even in harsh conditions.

Multiple Payload Configurations

Configure your M300 RTK to fit your mission needs. Mount up to 3 payloads simultaneously, with a maximum payload capacity of 2.7 kg.

Live Mission Recording

Record mission actions such as aircraft movement, gimbal orientation, photo shooting, and zoom level to create sample mission files for future automated inspections.

AI Spot-Check7

Automate routine inspections and capture consistent results every time. Onboard AI recognizes the subject of interest and identifies it in subsequent automated missions to ensure consistent framing.

Waypoints 2.

Create up to 65,535 waypoints and set multiple actions for one or more payloads, including 3rd party ones, at each waypoint. Flightpath planning is also optimized to maximize flexibility and efficiency for your missions.

PinPoint

Mark an object in camera or map view with a quick tap, and advanced sensor fusion algorithms will immediately calculate its coordinates, which are projected to all camera views as an AR icon. The location of the subject is automatically shared with another remote controller, or to online platforms such as DJI FlightHub9.

Smart Track

Identify and follow moving subjects like people, vehicles, and boats with the Smart Track function, where auto-zoom is applied for steady tracking and viewing. The subjects dynamic location is continuously acquired and shared to another remote controller or to DJI FlightHub9.

Aviation-Grade Situational Awareness

The M300 RTK adopts a new Primary Flight Display (PFD) that integrates flight, navigation, and obstacle information to empower the pilot with exceptional situational awareness.

Advanced Dual Control

Either operator can now obtain control of the aircraft or payload with a single tap. This creates new possibilities for mission strategies as well as higher flexibility during operations.

A Powerful Vision System You Can Rely On

To enhance in-flight safety and aircraft stability, dual-vision and ToF sensors appear on all six sides of the aircraft, offering a maximum detection range of up to 40 m, with options to customize the aircraftâ€™s sensing behavior via the DJI Pilot App. Even in complex operating environments, this 6 Directional Sensing and Positioning system helps keep the aircraft and the mission safe.

Professional Maintenance for Your Drone Fleet

The new integrated Health Management System displays the current status of all systems, notification logs, and a preliminary troubleshooting guide. Also in the system are the aircrafts flight logs, duration, and mileage throughout its entire lifecycle, and tips on aircraft care and maintenance.

products.name: DJI Matrice 350 RTK Drone
products.description:
DJI Matrice 350 RTK Drone

The DJI Matrice 350 RTK Drone is a reliable and powerful industrial drone with high-performance flying, precision positioning, and a wide range of payload choices. The drone has a folding design, an IP55-rated body, and a dual-battery system with a flying time of up to 55 minutes. The drone can also employ up to three DJI gimbals, including the Zenmuse H20 series, Zenmuse P1, and Zenmuse L1. The drone offers an omnidirectional vision system that detects and avoids obstacles in all directions, as well as an infrared sensing system for precise landing. The DJI Matrice 350 RTK Drone also has an RTK module that provides centimeter-level positional precision and is compatible with the NTRIP network RTK. The DJI O3 Enterprise Transmission technology provides clear and steady video transmission up to 20 kilometers distant. The drone comes with a 7-inch touchscreen remote controller that supports Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.1.

High-Performance Flight

The DJI Matrice 350 RTK Drone features a robust propulsion system that allows it to fly at speeds of up to 23 meters per second and withstand gusts of up to 12 meters per second. The drone boasts a dual-battery system with hot-swapping and self-heating capabilities, allowing for up to 55 minutes of flying duration without payloads. In addition, the drone includes a smart flying mode that automatically modifies flight characteristics based on payload arrangement and ambient conditions. The drone has several flying modes, including N, S, T, and A, as well as intelligent functions like waypoint mission, orbit, spotlight, and active track.

Precise Positioning

The DJI Matrice 350 RTK Drone features an RTK module with centimeter-level positional precision and NTRIP network RTK capability. For improved locating performance, the drone also has a GNSS module that supports GPS, GLONASS, BeiDou, and Galileo satellites. The drone can save satellite observation data for post-processed kinematics (PPK), which may be used with the DJI Terra software to build high-precision maps and models. When the GNSS signal is lost or weak, the RTK-aided inertial navigation system (RAINS) maintains high-precision positioning.

Omnidirectional Vision System

The DJI Matrice 350 RTK Drone features an omnidirectional vision system that detects and avoids obstacles in all directions, as well as an infrared sensor system for precise landing. Six pairs of cameras are situated on the front, rear, left, right, top, and bottom of the drone, as well as an infrared sensor at the bottom. Depending on the surroundings and speed of the drone, the vision system can identify obstructions from 0.7 m to 40 m away. The vision system also enables APAS (Advanced Pilot Assistance System) mode, which automatically prepares the optimal flying route to avoid obstructions. The infrared sensor device can detect obstructions from 0.1 m to 8 m away and has a range of vision of 30° (15°). The infrared sensing technology is intended for big, diffuse, and reflecting obstacles (reflectivity > 10%). The drone also contains an LED auxiliary light that offers good lighting up to 5 meters away. The LED light features a steady glow mode with a frequency of 60 Hz. The drone also contains an FPV camera that gives a 1080p live view with a field of view of 142° and a frame rate of 30 fps.

Intelligent Flight Battery

The DJI Matrice 350 RTK Drone is powered by the TB65 Intelligent Flying Battery, a high-capacity Li-ion battery that gives the drone up to 55 minutes of flying time. The battery has 5880 mAh of capacity, 44.76 V of voltage, and 263.2 Wh of energy. Intelligent functions such as self-discharge prevention, overcharge and discharge protection, low-temperature protection, and balancing charging are also supported by the battery. The battery may be charged using the provided power adapter, the optional DJI 100W USB-C Power Adapter, or the optional vehicle charger. The battery is also compatible with the optional Intelligent Battery Station, which can charge up to eight TB65 batteries and four WB37 batteries at the same time. The battery features four LED indicators that reflect the remaining power level and battery condition.

Multi-Payload Support

The DJI Matrice 350 RTK Drone is compatible with up to three DJI gimbals, including the Zenmuse H20 series, Zenmuse P1, and Zenmuse L1. The Zenmuse H20 series is a multi-sensor hybrid camera with zoom, wide-angle, thermal, and laser rangefinder capabilities. Zenmuse P1 is a full-frame camera capable of capturing 45 MP images as well as 3D data for photogrammetry applications. The Zenmuse L1 lidar sensor produces point clouds and digital elevation models for surveying and mapping applications. The drone can easily swap between gimbals and control them independently or concurrently. Third-party payloads are also supported by the drone using the SkyPort V2.0 converter or the DJI X-Port adapter.

products.description:
DJI Matrice 4T

The DJI Matrice 4T represents a state of the art quadcopter drone designed for professional aerial missions, featuring sophisticated imaging technology, reliable performance, and smart flight systems. This drone provides exceptional operational duration with up to 49 minutes of flight time and 42 minutes of hovering capability, making it perfectly suited for surveying, inspection, and tactical operations. The aircraft incorporates an advanced omnidirectional detection system that utilizes infrared and LiDAR technology, delivering accurate obstacle detection and steady flight control in challenging conditions. The DJI Matrice 4T drone features a comprehensive camera configuration with four specialized modules: a wide-angle 48 MP CMOS camera with 24mm-equivalent f/1.7 optics, a medium telephoto 48 MP camera with 70mm-equivalent f/2.8 optics, a telephoto 1/1.5" CMOS camera with 168mm-equivalent f/2.8 optics providing up to 112x digital magnification, and a thermal VOX camera that can detect temperatures ranging from -20 to 550°C. All cameras deliver UHD 4K video recording at 30 fps, with still photography reaching resolutions of up to 50.3 MP, providing outstanding clarity across all imaging modes. The aircraft demonstrates impressive speed performance with horizontal flight reaching 47 mph, climbing at 22.4 mph, and descending at 17.9 mph, while maintaining stability in winds up to 26.8 mph and operating at altitudes up to 3.7 miles. Operation is managed through a supplied controller featuring OcuSync 4.0 transmission technology, Wi-Fi 6, and Bluetooth 5.2 connectivity, enabling control distances up to 25 km. The DJI Matrice 4T includes a 7.02" high-brightness touchscreen interface, 128 GB built-in storage, and microSD card compatibility for enhanced workflow management. Featuring complete night vision capabilities, accurate RTK positioning, and durable construction rated for operation in temperatures between -20 to 50°C, the Matrice 4T emerges as an outstanding solution for professionals requiring dependable, high-quality, and precise aerial operations.

Flight Performance & Endurance

The DJI Matrice 4T sets a new benchmark in aerial endurance with a maximum flight time of 49 minutes and hover time of 42 minutes. Designed for demanding missions, it reaches speeds up to 47 mph and ascends at 22.4 mph. With wind resistance up to 26.8 mph and a take-off altitude of 3.7 miles, it thrives in challenging environments. Its quadcopter configuration and 10.8" propellers ensure stable flight, while omnidirectional sensing with infrared and LiDAR enhances safety. Whether for surveying, inspection, or tactical operations, the DJI Drone delivers unmatched reliability and precision in the sky.

Advanced Multi-Camera System

Equipped with four specialized cameras, the DJI Matrice 4T captures every detail across wide, medium telephoto, telephoto, and thermal spectrums. The wide and medium telephoto cameras feature 48 MP 1/1.3" CMOS sensors, while the telephoto camera boasts a 1/1.5" CMOS sensor with 50.3 MP resolution and 112x digital zoom. The thermal camera uses a VOX sensor with a temperature range of -20 to 550°C. Each camera supports UHD 4K video at 30 fps and high-resolution stills, making it ideal for industrial inspections, search and rescue, and environmental monitoring.

products.description:
DJI Mavic 2 Enterprise Drone

The DJI Mavic 2 Enterprise Dual is ideal for a Business start-up Drone, this versatile quad-copter packs a lot of features that can be utilized across various sectors thanks to an additional set of accessories that are carried over from the DJI Mavic 2 Enterprise. The DJI Mavic 2 Enterprise Dual includes a dual camera that houses two lenses – standard visual (zoom) and FLIR (Forward Looking Infra-Red) – speaker, floodlight, and beacon. The drone itself features the standard DJI Mavic style fold-out arms which provide a quicker setup time and deployment, within minutes if the situation requires. Some examples of sectors that this drone would be used for are; SAR (Search and Rescue), Emergency Services (Police, Fire, Coastguard), Commercial, Private and Industrial Inspections (visual and thermal), Restricted Area Control, Film production, aerial photography and many more.

Mode Elements

Some of the features include the advanced obstacle avoidance system reduces the risk of accidental contact with other objects improving the safety of each flight, Data Security, GPS timestamping, DJI AirSense, Ocusync 2.0 to name a few. A great feature that DJI has put some thought into is the inclusion of a Discreet Mode, this allows you to turn off the LEDs when performing a night mission to ensure you are not being obtrusive to anyone during your flight.

Perfect for Easy transport

The DJI Mavic 2 Enterprise Dual blazes the trail for Commercial Drone Businesses wanting to access multiple sectors. In the ever-growing drone market, trying to choose the right drone for your business can almost certainly leave you confused, lost and drowning in a mass of information. This drone may be small when compared to others on the market, but don’t let that put you off as this little terrier of the sky has a bite bigger than its bark! Being a smaller drone though does have its advantages: compact and easy to store therefore saving space, easily carried/transported to remote areas without the use of vehicles, fit and access small spaces and tight spots, can be operated from small take-off/landing areas.

Powerful and Portable thermal Imaging

Mavic 2 Enterprise Dual Drone features a three-axis gimbal stabilized camera housing a side-by-side 4K sensor for capturing visible light and a FLIR imaging sensor for capturing thermal data. Together these sensors allow pilots to perform flights at night, as well as fly in complex daytime conditions like fog and smoke. Users can select from multiple intelligent display modes in the DJI Pilot flight control app to visualize data from the dual-sensor camera: FLIR MSX – A new feature that combines data from the visual and thermal cameras in real time to enhance visual details, helping pilots quickly identify and interpret critical data that may not be immediately visible to the naked eye. This Drone has features like Spot Meter – Displays the average temperature of an object, helping pilots monitor and measure critical or hazardous objects while maintaining a safe distance. Area Measurement – Displays the average, lowest, and highest temperature, as well as the corresponding locations of each area, allowing inspectors to quickly assess objects and determine if an asset may be overheating. Isotherm – Allows pilots to designate specific temperature ranges to be displayed using a custom color palette so objects within the range relay higher contrast and better visibility. This feature includes custom profiles to aid search and rescue pilots in identifying people and to help firefighters identify hot spots in fires, as well as a custom profile setting for added flexibility.

Refined Imaging And Enhanced Vision

The imaging system has been developed with two goals in mind; assisting pilots in close-range missions; and ensuring captured data is more relevant and trusted than ever. DJI Mavic 2 Enterprise Dual Edition Drone is launched with a purpose of enhanced image visibility on all your captured data, Isotherm helps you get accurate heat measurements on a variety of objects and scenarios. You can Visualize scenarios in real time, monitor and measure objects on site more safely and efficiently so you can make the most informed decisions. Enhance image visibility for on-the ground team missions, Enhance image visibility for improved situational awareness and Create predefined isotherm setting.

Safety Features

DJI Mavic 2 Enterprise Dual Edition Drone comes with Shield Basic properties that include: User/Pilot Error, Signal Interference, Collision, Water Damage and Drop Damage.

Emergency response

The DJI Mavic 2 Enterprise Dual Edition Drone has the ability to go from packed away to in the air in mere minutes during emergency situations, making response times more effective. Using the Mavic 2 Enterprise is a cost-effective alternative to traditional helicopters and can help respond tactically to unexpected missions. Collect the necessary situational data to help minimize unforeseen dangers to crew and their surroundings, allowing for a safer mission.

DJI Smart Controller

The Mavic Duals smart controller was built for aircrafts with OcuSync 2.0 and made to enhance your outdoor flying experience with its ultra-bright 5.5-inch 1080p display. Allowing for clear visibility and brighter images even in less than desirable conditions like direct sunlight. It boasts intuitive controls and pre-installed apps like SkyTalk and DJI Go helping you get in the air more quickly than ever before. Third-party apps are also supported, so drone pilots have a complete choice when it comes to operational controls. The smart controller lets you connect to a HDMI port and microSD card slot, and operates at 1000 cd/m2 brightness.

Standard Remote Controller

The Mavic dual’s standard remote controller boasts 135 minutes of battery life when fully charged - leaving you plenty of time to capture what you need in the field. It is also built with an ergonomic design that allows for easy storage with its foldable body and detachable sticks. This design works exceptionally well with smartphones and gives an enhanced operational experience to use the DJI Mavic 2 Enterprise Dual Edition Drone.

products.name: DJI Mavic 3 Classic Combo Drone
products.description:
DJI Mavic 3 Classic Combo Drone

The DJI Mavic 3 Classic Combo Drone is a small and portable drone that can take high-quality aerial photos and videos. The drone is equipped with a Hasselblad camera with a 4/3 CMOS sensor capable of recording up to 5.1K video and 20 MP images, as well as a 3x digital zoom function. The drone also incorporates an omnidirectional vision system for obstacle detection and avoidance in all directions, as well as a bottom-mounted infrared sensor for precision landing. The drone boasts a folding design that makes it easy to transport and store, as well as an IP55-rated casing that keeps dust and water out. The drone includes a dual-battery system with hot-swapping and self-heating capabilities. With the O3+ video transmission technology, the drone can fly for up to 46 minutes on a single battery and has a maximum transmission distance of 15 kilometers. The DJI Mavic 3 Classic Combo Drone features 8 GB of in-built storage and can accept microSD cards up to 512 GB in size. The drone has a strong propulsion system that allows it to fly at speeds of up to 21 meters per second and withstand gusts of up to 12 meters per second. The drone also has a GNSS module that supports GPS, Galileo, and BeiDou satellites for improved positioning. The drone can save satellite observation data for post-processed kinematics (PPK), which may be used with the DJI Terra software to build high-precision maps and models. When the GNSS signal is lost or weak, the RTK-aided inertial navigation system (RAINS) maintains high-precision positioning.

Hasselblad Camera with Digital Zoom

The Hasselblad camera in the DJI Mavic 3 Classic has a 4/3 CMOS sensor and produces stunning picture quality and dynamic range. The camera can capture 5.1K video at 30 frames per second or 4K video at 120 frames per second, as well as 20 MP photographs in JPEG or RAW format. In addition, the camera supports H.264/H.265 codecs for optimal storage and editing. The camera features a 24 mm equivalent lens, an aperture range of f/2.8-f/11, and a focus range of 1 m to infinity. The camera also includes a 3x digital zoom mode, allowing you to go closer to your subject without sacrificing image quality.

Omnidirectional Obstacle Sensing and Avoidance

The DJI Mavic 3 Classic has an omnidirectional vision technology that detects and avoids obstacles in all directions, assuring safe and smooth flying. Six pairs of cameras are situated on the front, rear, left, right, top, and bottom of the drone, as well as an infrared sensor at the bottom for accurate landing. Depending on the surroundings and speed of the drone, the system can identify impediments from 0.5 m to 200 m away. APAS (Advanced Pilot Assistance System) mode is also supported, which automatically prepares the optimal flying route to avoid obstructions.

Long Flight Time and Transmission Range

The DJI Mavic 3 Classic features a large battery that allows you up to 46 minutes of flying duration on a single charge, letting you to take more footage without interruption. The battery may also be charged quickly using the supplied charger or the optional DJI 100W USB-C Power Adapter. The drone also features an O3+ video transmission technology, which provides crisp and reliable live view quality up to 1080p at 60 frames per second. The system can transmit data at 2.4 GHz and 5.8 GHz frequencies and has a maximum transmission distance of 15 km in an unobstructed and interference-free environment. Wi-Fi 6 is also supported for quicker data transfer.

Intelligent Flight Battery

The DJI Mavic 3 Classic Combo Drone takes advantage of the DJI Mavic 3 Intelligent flying Battery, a high-capacity Li-ion 4S battery that gives the drone up to 46 minutes of flying duration. The battery contains 5000 mAh of capacity, 15.4 V of nominal voltage, and 77 Wh of energy. Intelligent functions such as self-discharge prevention, overcharge and discharge protection, low-temperature protection, and balancing charging are also supported by the battery. The supplied power adapter, the optional DJI 100W USB-C Power Adapter, or the optional vehicle charger may all be used to charge the battery. The battery is also compatible with the optional battery charging hub, which can charge up to three batteries simultaneously. The battery contains four LED indicators that reflect the battery's remaining power level and status.

products.description:
DJI Mavic 3 Pro Fly More Combo 4K Drone with Remote Controller

The DJI Mavic 3 Pro Fly More Combo Drone with Remote Controller is equipped with a Hasselblad camera with a 4/3 CMOS sensor capable of recording up to 5.1K video and 20 MP images, as well as two additional cameras for medium and tele zoom. The drone also incorporates an omnidirectional binocular vision system for obstacle detection and avoidance in all directions, as well as a bottom-mounted infrared sensor for precision landing. With the O3+ video transmission technology, the DJI Mavic 3 Pro Fly More Combo Drone can fly for up to 43 minutes on a single battery and has a maximum transmission distance of 15 kilometers.

Hasselblad Camera with Three Lenses

It features a Hasselblad camera with a 4/3 CMOS sensor, which produces amazing image quality and dynamic range. The camera can capture 5.1K video at 30 frames per second or 4K video at 120 frames per second, as well as 20 MP photographs in JPEG or RAW format. For professional editing, the camera also supports Apple ProRes 422 HQ/422/422 LT codecs. The DJI Mavic 3 Pro Fly More Combo Drone also includes two additional cameras for medium and telephoto zoom, giving a total optical zoom range of 1-28x. The medium tele camera has a 1/1.3′′ CMOS sensor and a lens equivalent to 70mm, whilst the tele camera has a 1/2′′ CMOS sensor and a lens comparable to 166mm. The three cameras collaborate to deliver smooth zooming and change between focus lengths.

Omnidirectional Obstacle Sensing and Avoidance

The DJI Mavic 3 Pro has an omnidirectional binocular vision technology that detects and avoids obstacles in all directions, assuring safe and smooth flying. Six pairs of cameras are situated on the front, rear, left, right, top, and bottom of the drone, as well as an infrared sensor at the bottom for accurate landing. Depending on the surroundings and speed of the drone, the system can identify impediments from 0.5 m to 200 m away. APAS (Advanced Pilot Assistance System) mode is also supported, which automatically prepares the optimal flying route to avoid obstructions.

Long Flight Time and Transmission Range

The DJI Mavic 3 Pro offers a large battery that can give up to 43 minutes of flying duration on a single charge, letting you take more footage without interruption. The battery may also be charged quickly using the supplied charger or the optional DJI 100W USB-C Power Adapter. The drone also features an O3+ video transmission technology, which provides crisp and reliable live view quality up to 1080p at 60 frames per second. The system can transmit data at 2.4 GHz and 5.8 GHz frequencies and has a maximum transmission distance of 15 km in an unobstructed and interference-free environment. Wi-Fi 6 is also supported for quicker data transfer.

Intelligent Flight Battery

The DJI Mavic 3 pro Intelligent Flying Battery is a high-performance Li-ion 4S battery with a flying duration of up to 43 minutes. The battery contains 5000 mAh of capacity, 15.4 V of nominal voltage, and 77 Wh of energy. Intelligent functions such as self-discharge prevention, overcharge and discharge protection, low-temperature protection, and balancing charging are also supported by the battery. The supplied power adapter, the optional DJI 100W USB-C Power Adapter, or the optional vehicle charger may all be used to charge the battery. The battery is also compatible with the optional battery charging hub, which can charge up to three batteries simultaneously. The battery contains four LED indicators that reflect the battery's remaining power level and status.

DJI Mavic 4 Pro Fly More Combo

The DJI Mavic 4 Pro Fly More Combo is a top-tier drone package designed for professional aerial photography and videography, offering unmatched performance, camera quality, and flight intelligence. At its core, the DJI Mavic 4 Pro Drone features a groundbreaking 3-axis 360° infinity gimbal that supports a high-end triple-camera system: a 100MP Hasselblad wide-angle lens (4/3 CMOS capable of 6K60 HDR video), a 48MP medium telephoto lens (1/1.3 CMOS 4K60 HDR), and a 50MP telephoto lens (1/1.5 CMOS 4K60 HDR). With up to 70° upward shooting, the DJI Mavic 4 Pro captures dramatic and creative angles like never before.

Fly More Combo

The Fly More Combo edition of the DJI Mavic 4 Pro enhances your flying experience by extending flight time and adding essential accessories for convenience and readiness. Unlike the standard version, the Fly More Combo includes two extra intelligent flight batteries, giving you a total of three batteries—ideal for longer shoots and extended missions without interruption. To complement this, a parallel charging hub is included, allowing you to recharge multiple batteries efficiently and simultaneously. The combo also comes with three extra pairs of spare propellers, ensuring you are always prepared in case of damage or wear.

Multiple Camera System

The DJI Mavic 4 Pro Fly More Combo features a cutting-edge triple-camera system on its Infinity Gimbal, designed for versatile cinematic capture of nature, architecture, and wildlife. Its 100MP Hasselblad wide-angle camera supports 6K60 HDR video, offers exceptional low-light performance, and integrates HNCS for accurate color reproduction. A 48MP medium telephoto lens excels in portraits and subject isolation, while the 50MP telephoto lens delivers sharp long-range shots with a flattened perspective. All three cameras support 4K60 HDR, with slow-motion up to 4K120 and features like dual native ISO fusion, RAW stacking, and advanced creative modes. With 10-bit D-Log, the system ensures professional-grade color and flexibility in post-production.

O4+ Transmission

The DJI Mavic 4 Pro Fly More Combo is equipped with advanced O4 plus transmission technology, delivering crystal clear 10 bit HDR video from up to 18.6 miles away. This next generation system ensures you always have a sharp, accurate view of what you are capturing from the ground, even over extreme distances. Designed for reliability, O4 plus features enhanced algorithms that significantly reduce signal dropouts and interference, making it ideal for use in challenging environments like dense urban areas. The DJI Mavic 4 Pro Creator Combo With RC Pro 2 is a flagship drone package engineered for professionals who demand precision, power, and premium imaging. The camera system on the DJI Mavic 4 Pro Creator Combo includes a 100MP wide-angle lens with a 4/3" CMOS sensor, a 48MP medium telephoto lens, and a 50MP telephoto lens, each supporting high-resolution photography and 4K 60fps HDR video. Users can capture detailed visuals with various photography modes including AEB, burst, interval, and single shot, with support for JPEG and RAW formats, and video in MP4/MOV using H.264 or H.265. The DJI Mavic 4 Pro Creator Combo With RC Pro 2 delivers outstanding aerial performance, with a maximum ascent and descent speed of 22.4 mph, wind resistance up to Level 5 (10.7 m/s), and an extended flight time of up to 51 minutes. With 128GB internal storage and microSD expansion, the controller operates across multiple frequencies including 2.4GHz, 5.1GHz, and 5.8GHz using enterprise-grade antennas for stable connectivity. The intelligent flight battery powering the DJI Mavic 4 Pro Creator Combo features 6654mAh capacity and supports fast charging via PD protocol for efficient recharging. With obstacle detection in all directions, robust design, and operating temperature from -10°C to 40°C, the DJI Mavic 4 Pro Creator Combo With RC Pro 2 is ideal for professional cinematography, inspections, and advanced aerial missions. Lightweight at around 750g and foldable for portability, this drone combo is the perfect all-in-one solution for high-performance, long-range, and high-quality drone operations.

Multiple Camera System

The DJI Mavic 4 Pro Creator Combo has an advanced triple-camera system on its Infinity Gimbal that allows for diverse cinematic capturing of nature, architecture, and animals. Its 100MP Hasselblad wide-angle camera shoots 6K60 HDR video, has excellent low-light performance, and has HNCS for accurate color reproduction. ActiveTrack 360° Just Got More Powerful

At its core, the DJI Mavic 4 Pro Drone features a groundbreaking 3-axis 360° infinity gimbal that supports a high-end triple-camera system: a 100MP Hasselblad wide-angle lens (4/3 CMOS capable of 6K60 HDR video), a 48MP medium telephoto lens (1/1.3 CMOS 4K60 HDR), and a 50MP telephoto lens (1/1.5 CMOS 4K60 HDR). With up to 70° upward shooting, the DJI Mavic 4 Pro captures dramatic and creative angles like never before. This drone also includes an advanced omnidirectional obstacle sensing system enhanced with LiDAR and infrared, capable of 0.1-lux low-light performance, making it ideal for night flying and complex environments. Its intelligent ActiveTrack 360 and front-facing LiDAR sensor enable seamless subject and vehicle tracking. The DJI Mavic 4 Pro Standard Combo also includes the DJI RC 2 remote controller equipped with a 5.5-inch FHD touchscreen, offering intuitive control and up to an 18.6-mile transmission range via the upgraded O4 plus system. Operating in temperatures from -10°C to 40°C, it provides pinpoint hovering accuracy using GNSS and vision positioning, and includes 64GB internal storage plus microSDXC card support. Weighing only 2.3 lbs folded, the DJI Mavic 4 Pro Standard Combo is a must-have for creators who demand portability, power, and professional-grade imaging in one compact package.

Multiple Camera System

The DJI Mavic 4 Pro Standard Combo features a cutting-edge triple-camera system on its Infinity Gimbal, designed for versatile cinematic capture of nature, architecture, and wildlife. Its 100MP Hasselblad wide-angle camera supports 6K60 HDR video, offers exceptional low-light performance, and integrates HNCS for accurate color reproduction. A 48MP medium telephoto lens excels in portraits and subject isolation, while the 50MP telephoto lens delivers sharp long-range shots with a flattened perspective. All three cameras support 4K60 HDR, with slow-motion up to 4K120 and features like dual native ISO fusion, RAW stacking, and advanced creative modes. With 10-bit D-Log, the system ensures professional-grade color and flexibility in post-production.

O4+ Transmission

products.description:
DJI Mini 5 Pro Fly More Combo With RC2

The DJI Mini 5 Pro Fly More Combo is a small but powerful drone built for creators who want great image quality, intelligent flight performance, and long battery life in a lightweight package. This drone's 1-inch CMOS sensor with 50MP effective pixels, an f/1.8 aperture, and a 24mm format equivalent lens capture amazing detail in images and movies. The DJI Mini 5 Pro Fly More Combo supports ISO ranges of 100 to 12800 for video and up to 6400 for stills, offering outstanding clarity even in adverse circumstances. Photographers can select from many shooting modes, such as single shots, burst, timed, and automatic exposure bracketing, with image sizes up to 8192×6144 pixels. The DJI Mini 5 Pro Fly More Combo can record video in 4K at up to 120fps and Full HD at up to 240fps, encoded in H.264 or H.265 with a maximum bitrate of 130Mbps. For professional-grade film, color settings include Normal, HDR, HLG, and D-Log M, as well as 10-bit recording.

1-Inch CMOS Sensor

A 1-inch CMOS sensor is included inside the DJI Mini 5 Pro Fly More Combo, enabling 4K/60 fps HDR video recording with up to 14 stops of dynamic range for dramatic images. With the help of sophisticated algorithms and advanced image processing technologies, this big sensor captures even the smallest details in low light, such nightscapes and sunsets, producing photographs that are utterly stunning. Subjects are more noticeable in the picture when using the DJI Mini 5 Pro Fly More Combo 48mm Med-Tele mode, and portrait optimization algorithms capture each expression with amazing clarity.

True Vertical Shooting and 225° Flexible Gimbal Rotation

Wide-angle roll rotation and full vertical shooting are supported with the DJI Mini 5 Pro Fly More Combo, which expands camera movement options. More creative compositions are possible thanks to the increased versatility in camera angles and flight paths offered by both manual control and intelligent modes. Unusual perspectives that were previously hard to capture can now be easily obtained, even when shooting upward at big structures or from difficult angles, completely unleashing creative inspiration.

Upgraded ActiveTrack 360°

No matter where you go, the DJI Mini 5 Pro Fly More Combo records every moment. The updated ActiveTrack 360° has safer and more reliable tracking performance along with customisable tracking in a variety of settings. For the best framing and tracking, the DJI Mini 5 Pro automatically chooses between the Cycling or Standard mode when it detects sports situations. When in Standard mode, the drone tracks you in real time while staying at a constant distance and altitude. It responds swiftly to turns and changes in speed when in cycling mode, keeping you locked in and in the ideal frame.

DJI Mini 5 Pro Fly More Combo With RC-N3

The DJI Mini 5 Pro Fly More Combo is a compact yet powerful drone designed for creators who demand exceptional image quality, intelligent flight performance, and extended battery life in a lightweight package. Equipped with a 1-inch CMOS sensor offering 50MP effective pixels, an f/1.8 aperture, and a 24mm format equivalent lens, this drone captures stunningly detailed photos and videos in any lighting condition. The DJI Mini 5 Pro Fly More Combo supports a wide ISO range of 100–12800 for video and up to 6400 for still images, ensuring clear and vibrant results even in low light. Creators can choose from multiple shooting modes, including single shot, burst, timed, and automatic exposure bracketing, with a maximum image resolution of 8192×6144 pixels. For video, it delivers professional-grade results with 4K recording at up to 120fps and Full HD at up to 240fps, encoded in H.264 or H.265 at a maximum bitrate of 130Mbps. To enhance cinematic production, the DJI Mini 5 Pro Fly More Combo supports 10-bit recording and advanced color profiles such as Normal, HDR, HLG, and D-Log M, giving creators flexibility in post-production. Perfect for professional filmmakers, aerial photographers, and hobbyists, this drone offers a powerful combination of portability and performance.

1-Inch CMOS Sensor

The DJI Mini 5 Pro Fly More Combo has a 1-inch CMOS sensor, which allows for 4K/60 fps HDR video recording with up to 14 stops of dynamic range for stunning photos. With the aid of sophisticated algorithms and powerful image processing technologies, this large sensor captures even the finest details in low light, such as nightscapes and sunsets, resulting in spectacular images. When utilizing the DJI Mini 5 Pro Fly More Combo 48mm Med-Tele mode, subjects stand out in the image, and portrait optimization algorithms capture each expression with incredible detail.

True Vertical Shooting and 225° Flexible Gimbal Rotation

To increase camera movement choices, the DJI Mini 5 Pro Fly More Combo supports complete vertical shooting and wide-angle roll rotation. The greater flexibility in camera angles and flight paths provided by both manual control and intelligent modes allows for more imaginative compositions. Unusual viewpoints that were previously difficult to capture are now readily available, even when looking aloft at large structures or from challenging angles, releasing creative creativity.

Upgraded ActiveTrack 360°

The DJI Mini 5 Pro Fly More Combo captures everything you do, no matter where you are. Customizable tracking in several settings and safer and more dependable tracking performance are features of the new ActiveTrack 360°. When the DJI Mini 5 Pro recognizes a sporting event, it automatically switches between the Cycling and Standard modes for optimal framing and tracking. When in Standard mode, the drone monitors you in real time while maintaining a consistent distance and height. When riding, it responds quickly to twists and changes in speed, keeping you locked in and in the right position.

The DJI Mini 2 SE Fly More Combo Drone is a less expensive alternative of the Mini 2, but it retains most of its functionality, including the same 36 mph flying speed, up to 6.2-mile OcuSync 2.0 video transmission, and more. The Mini 2 SE also provides ease, making it simple and enjoyable for both beginners and specialists. QuickShots and panoramic clever pre-programmed flight modes provide professional results with a single swipe. Despite its lightweight frame, the Mini 2 SE is quite safe to use, due to its excellent wind resistance and return-to-home features. You receive extra batteries, a shoulder bag, and other goodies with this Fly More Combo edition of the Mini 2 SE right out of the box.

Handy and Portable

The DJI Mini SE Fly More Combo Drone is handy and incredibly portable, is a fun drone alternative for usage at home or on vacation. The Mini 2 SE, weighing less than 0.55 lb with battery, propellers, and an optional microSD card, does not require registration in the United States.

OcuSync 2.0

To operate the Mini 2 SE, connect your current mobile phone into the supplied RC-N1 remote controller, and HD footage of what the drone views is broadcast back to the phone's display. This footage can be streamed from up to 6.2 miles distant thanks to DJI's dual-band OcuSync 2.0 video transmission technology.

QuickShots

It doesn't take an expert pilot to capture cinematic video with the Mini 2 SE's clever flying modes. These modes are known as QuickShots, and they each throw the Mini 2 SE into a complicated and accurate flying pattern while filming a subject. You have the option of selecting Dronie, Helix, Rocket, Circle, or Boomerang.

DJI Fly App

The DJI Fly app offers you access to several of the Mini 2 SE's functionalities, such as QuickShots and Panoramas, and allows you to create stunning results that include a soundtrack and filters. The DJI Fly app provides clear operating instructions and simple flying courses for novices.

products.name: DJI P4 Multispectral Drone
products.description:
DJI P4 Multispectral Drone

The DJI P4 Multispectral Agricultural Drone can be a useful tool in monitoring, understanding, and treating concerns connected to crop and vegetation health with information that is invisible to the human eye. This is true for both environmental research and agriculture. This drone can look below the surface since it has a gimbal with a 6-camera array. The other five cameras each capture a different wavelength, while one camera is an RGB camera that only records visible light and takes conventional images. The other five cameras record 2MP images in wavelengths including red edge, near-infrared, green, red, and blue. Even while flying at higher speeds, the resulting photographs are clear thanks to the global shutter and 3-axis stabilized gimbal. To maximize data collection and concentrate on the regions that require the most attention, you can flip between the two feeds while flying. An integrated spectral sunlight sensor on the top of the P4 Multispectral quadcopter works in conjunction with the gimbal camera to achieve the most accurate NDVI results possible. The sensor captures solar irradiance to help increase accuracy and maintain consistency in processed data through different times of the day.

RTK Compatible

The DJI P4 Multispectral Drone includes an RTK module that can be used to help increase the accuracy of GPS location data. The P4 Multispectral is compatible with the optional D-RTK 2 Mobile Station and NTRIP.

Centimeter-Level Precision

The DJI P4 Multispectral Drone's real-time, centimeter-accurate data collection in imaging is made possible by DJI's TimeSync system. TimeSync causes the P4 to continuously align the gimbal camera, RTK module, and flight controller, setting the location to the CMOS's center. This helps offer the post-processing software for your photos incredibly precise metadata.
